name: Lost Traits
description: Optional house rule by Bluefire (idea: Borja): thirteen official heroes and alter-egos gain one trait another card of the same character already has (Web-Warrior, Avenger, Aerial, Defender, Mutant), or Martial Artist for heroes whose lore is built on it. Nothing else changes. Turn it on per game in Table setup; the rebuilt card faces show while it is on.

permission.evidence: Bluefire's own house rule, in the curated repository he keeps: https://github.com/bluefireF5ran/mc-digital-custom-packs/blob/a51e50da556ece0b0fe9a75848320416b8794cef/lost_traits_bf/mod.json (permission: status "own", scope "inclusion"); confirmed by the project owner (Quin Carter) on 2026-11-13.
permission.scope: inclusion: the author's own work, in English and Spanish (both by Bluefire)
permission.note: The source records the status as "own" (the author's own work) with no date; 2026-11-13 is the owner's confirmation. The idea is Borja's, from the Digital Discord server, and the server's poll approved the rule (2026-11).
